profile.headline: Senior Platform Software Engineer at The New York Times
profile.summary: I am a dedicated Full Stack Developer currently working as a Senior Platform Software Engineer at The New York Times Games team. I have experience building applications and RESTful APIs using Go, Java, Python, Javascript, React, GraphQL and SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with UX, engineers, product management, and users to develop a Team Metrics dashboard using a Go backend and React frontend
- Worked with the Application Platforms / Pivotal Cloud Foundry team to gather metrics and build applications that assist other developers with maintaining and deploying their software
- Worked on the Emergency Visibility team by developing improvements and fixes to the reporting engine, data loads, and UI
- Involved in Teradata Retirement; built and scheduled data loads from on various on prem sources to cloud to meet urgent company-wide deadline
- Worked on Product Safety team using Java/SpringBoot backend and React frontend to maintain, optimize, and add features to Product Feedback application

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Worked on The Home Depot Supply Chain Analytics team to load, process, and schedule data from several sources to Google Cloud Services

positions.title: Interactive Developer
positions.description:
- Worked in Unity3D and C# to create interactive virtual reality experiences in Google Cardboard, Oculus Rift, and HTC Vive
- Created a pharmaceutical sales rep training simulation for Google Cardboard and an interactive car test drive experience for Oculus Rift

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
- Oversee all aspects of online content and product pages for Makita’s largest retailer, The Home Depot
- Augmented gross demand on Home Depot by 40.9% YTD (approx. $5.5M) through online marketing management and demand forecasting; increased online gross unit by 40.3% YTD (approx. 33K units).
- Conceptualize and implement new marketing plans leading to growth in retail channel business.
- Manage entire digital content and pages for products on e-commerce websites; ensure timely updates are in line with retail channel specifications and requirements.
- Initiate and utilize market research, competitive analysis, and qualified metrics to develop effective strategies and communications plans.
- Develop and design advertising campaigns and promote new product marketing ideas.
- Assist creative team, product managers, and emerging markets, with discovering, creating, and implementing promotional initiatives for retail customers conducive to more business.
- Collaborate and coordinate with marketing, purchasing, logistics, sales, accounting, and service departments.
- Monitor trends and prepare reports on e-commerce based retail channel program initiatives.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed daily product listings on top three leading retail platforms (Amazon, Wal-Mart, Sam’s Club). 
- Reduced costs by saving thousands of dollars through in-house graphic design and marketing collaterals.
- Increased online presence and brand familiarity through social media; successfully increased Facebook Likes by 200%+. Implemented innovative marketing strategies. 
- Acted as liaison between Design, Engineering, Production, and Sales departments to determine requirements and roadmaps leading to scaling product selection and improving target marketing. 
- Created and maintained website and content including product specs, fact sheets, images, and verbiage.
- Developed presentations and reports based on latest competitive trends in new products and pricing.
- Scrutinized and accumulated latest NPD data, pricing grids, market intelligence reports, sell thru data and presented findings during weekly strategic team meetings.
- Monitored digital trends of interaction, analysis, and reported online usage and traffic metrics, in order to identify opportunities, and propose relevant programs.

positions.title: Product & Brand Specialist
positions.description:
- Worked at TCL Chinese Theatres to promote TCL brand and demonstrate TCL electronics; i.e.: 4K Ultra HD TVs, tablets, and smartphones. Hired, trained, and managed on-site employees.
- Drove TCL’s strategic vendors marketing efforts, including creation of marketing plans, building creative assets, identifying best customer targets, executing campaigns and analyzing results.
- Monitored all aspects of product lifecycle, including long- and short-term development and marketing.
- Assisted numerous marketing and email efforts, scheduled product lists, analyzed site promotions’ performance and made recommendations on marketing plans; communicated with employees and engineers to troubleshoot and handle technical issues.

positions.title: Marketing & Sales Assistant
positions.description:
- Set up each new item within internal system; communicated with clients to ensure content accuracy.
- Performed market research and analysis; gathered pricing data from retailers to analyze trends. 
- Researched and coordinated marketing efforts and assisted with smooth business operations. 
- Assisted in marketing operations by compiling, formatting, and reporting information and materials.
- Designed ads, mockups, and product specification sheets; supported sales teams.

positions.title: Marketing & Operations Assistant
positions.description:
- Analyzed market trends and recommended changes to marketing and business development strategies.
- Commenced and executed Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) to simplify and reduce shipping costs.
- Supervised E-commerce platforms to upload and edit product listings across multiple channels.
- Delivered operational support for digital media programs including video, display, and SEO.
- Addressed customer issues, filled orders and inspected merchandise coming in and going out; provided management with insights to further increase productivity.

positions.title: Copywriter
positions.description:
- Brainstormed ideas; transcribed and abridged product descriptions, product features, and search terms/keywords.
- Gathered customer requirements and pitched products appropriately to make a sale.
- Augmented sales volume by 300%+ in six months by scheduling inventory based on market research and trends; exercised competitive pricing strategies, monitored costs, competition, and supply and demand.

projects.title: Furriendster
projects.description:
Furriendster is a website for local pet owners to find other pet owners in their area to connect and set up play dates for their furry friends. It features a signup/login page, a page to register their pet personality profile, upload pet photos, search pet owners or dog parks within their neighborhood, and chat application. 
Made with JavaScript, Node.js, React, Redux, Express, Ajax, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, Cloudinary API, Google Maps API,  HTML, CSS, jQuery, JSX.
https://github.com/debramaelee/furriendster
